_comment: Chart pane and chart right-click menu 103 (src/ui/shell/ChartPane.tsx, ChartMenu.tsx, MixedChartDialog.tsx). Menu commands go to the active view, so they are posted on Chakras > Many Vargas (a CChartView fills it; slot 0 = D-1), each followed by Basics > Key Info (copy 32974: the birth time) with the mode label 'After: ...': 33076 When will lagna change (message box text in 'dialogs'), 33186 / 33187 move the birth time to the next / previous lagna sign, 33188 / 33189 undo the latest / all changes. Then the left chart pane on Basics > Key Info (GDI draws: 6 charts in packed mode, DisplayVarga[0..5]), Tajaka 2000 (button 1000) and the mixed Tajaka-natal window (button 1012, handler 0x4853e0: a new CMixedChartView frame, natal D-1 inside, Tajaka D-1 outside, 'Outer: Tajaka annual'), Chakras > Mixed 2-Vargas with the Tajaka chart shown, and back to the natal chart (1001). Runs: (a) no --ini -> golden/jhora-chartpane; (b) --ini UseTwoChartStyles=1 --ini ChartStyle2=2 -> golden/jhora-chartpane-twostyles (slots 2k and 2k+1 show DisplayVarga[2k] in ChartStyle and ChartStyle2); (c) --ini MoreChartsOnBigDisplay=0 -> golden/jhora-chartpane-unpacked (2 charts). Restore UseTwoChartStyles=0 and MoreChartsOnBigDisplay=1 in the copy's jhora.ini afterwards. tests/chartPane.test.ts skips while these directories are absent.

modes: Before: Lagna to next sign again
After: Lagna to next sign again
